record.content: Remind 0.13.0 fuses the lexical and vector recall arms with weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion instead of blending raw scores. Cosine similarity and BM25 rank are not on a comparable scale, so fusing ranks sidesteps score normalisation entirely. The pre-existing hybrid_keyword_weight config was repurposed from a keyword-overlap bonus into the weight of the lexical arm in the fusion, and a new rrf_k constant damps how much rank position matters.
